title: Natural gamma dose rate from soil K, U and Th
method: D = 13.078·K[%] + 5.675·U[ppm] + 2.494·Th[ppm] (standard soil-to-dose factors, UNSCEAR 2000) applied to the Lunar Prospector K, U and Th layers. Relative indicator of soil radioactivity; excludes galactic cosmic rays and solar particle events, which dominate the total lunar dose. Bilinear resampling of the 0.5° simple-cylindrical product (longitude wraps at ±180°). True footprint ~60–150 km: finer grids add no detail.

sources.name: Lunar Prospector GRS/NS special products (0.5°)
